name: UT Interactive forms
description: Unit tests of every Interactive form command: the form UT Item Form.form.json is shown without waiting, every change is made by the agent itself and read back, then the form is closed. It opens a window on the screen.

variables.name: ut_dir
variables.description: Folder with the test data (files, workbooks, fixtures).

variables.name: standin_url
variables.description: Address of the local stand-in that imitates outside services.

variables.name: ut_report
variables.description: One line per case: PASS or FAIL, the command and the case.

variables.name: items_dir
variables.description: Folder with the sample items (agents/items of the repository); the agent copies what it needs into its work folder.
